description: Verify a carbon project's MRV claim via Sentinel-2 and MWCM-Oh. Returns signed Ed25519 attestation with Lean 4 proof hash. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14, ISO 14064-3. Not a carbon credit certificate. Cost £150 per call.

claimed_ndvi_min.description: Minimum NDVI the agent claims the project has achieved. Used for Lean 4 verification.

node_id.description: Registry node ID for the asset (e.g., 'TN-KEN-0001').

project_id.description: Unique identifier of the carbon project (e.g., 'CV-SOUTHAMPTON-01').

name: request_mrv_report

outputSchema.description: FACT-sealed Carbon Vault MRV report after payment.

lean4_proof_hash.description: Hash of the Lean 4 compilation used for NDVI bounds.

ok.description: True when the tool completed without a validation error.

payment.description: Settlement receipt after x402 or sandbox payment.

report.description: Project telemetry, claimed NDVI, and seal status.

tool.description: Tool name that produced this payload.
